items.title: If nothing changes, how many months until checkout capacity is exceeded?
items.description: Drag the checkout database's current utilization, its monthly traffic growth rate, and a peak-event multiplier (Black Friday-level traffic is about 3x normal) to see how many months out the database crosses 100% of its connection pool capacity. At the unit's own numbers (62% current, 8%/month growth, 1x peak) that's about 6 months — drag the peak multiplier up to 3x and watch it hit 0: at Black-Friday-level traffic, capacity is already exceeded today, not in the future.
items.compute: const effectiveStart = params.currentUtilizationPercent * params.peakTrafficMultiplier; let months; if (effectiveStart >= 100) { months = 0; } else { months = Math.log(100 / effectiveStart) / Math.log(1 + params.monthlyGrowthRatePercent / 100); } return { monthsUntilCapacityExceeded: Math.round(months * 10) / 10 };
